purpose: Explicit acceptance for the planner contract and bounded repair; synthetic unless explicitly labelled private replay.

cases.input: Chief-only morning request with actionable mail and an upcoming calendar event.
cases.expected: Inbox and People may receive relevant sources with null direct request; Chief-only request text never enters specialist input.

cases.input: Direct Content and Brand request plus a public essay; private mail canary elsewhere.
cases.expected: Exact editor role/task request is legal; wrong-role/wrong-task request and private source remain rejected; public document needs explicit brand selection.

cases.input: First returned plan has a wrong-role request binding.
cases.expected: Record original failure and fixed diagnostics; at most one fresh model repair using unchanged inputs/options; no rejected model prose becomes authority.

cases.input: Both planner attempts violate the contract, including after restart.
cases.expected: Stop after two attempts, zero specialists/outbox, with both outputs retained; no restart allowance reset.

cases.input: Interrupt after rejection, after successful repair, or during failed-step receipt acknowledgement.
cases.expected: Reconstruct repair from retained evidence, reconcile the same hosted event first, preserve actual inputHash separately from logicalInputHash/schemaHash, and reuse saved valid work.

cases.input: Cancellation, expired/revoked host lease, account/context mismatch, isolation failure, or exhausted budget.
cases.expected: No plan-repair inference is launched; existing error/cancellation behavior remains.

cases.input: Host receives running→failed→running→completed on the same lease.
cases.expected: Second attempt succeeds only after first failed is recorded; stale fence and third attempt remain rejected.

cases.input: Actual operational model receives the synthetic morning packet in three fresh plan sessions.
cases.expected: Report every first-attempt result and any repair; useful Inbox/People work remains rather than returning empty solely to pass schema.

cases.input: Actual operational model receives fixed diagnostics for a known rejected synthetic plan.
cases.expected: Correct the request binding without changing permissions, exposing private sources, or dropping all useful work.
Return no specialist steps without fabricating sources or filler.

cases.input: Owner confirms Alex introduced Blair to Casey and Blair promises a same-day update that is not overdue.
cases.expected: Preserve relationship direction, pending obligation, no duplicate introduction request or gratuitous draft.

cases.input: Saved bounded real packet from the failed schedule is replayed after the fix.
cases.expected: Record a distinct manual replay, preserve original scheduled failure, inspect every actual output; partial coverage and undelivered state remain explicit.

cases.input: Synthesis tries to select stepId chief for a finding already in its own chiefFindings, or selects a nonexistent/incomplete specialist result.
cases.expected: Generated schema exposes only actual completed step/finding pairs. Chief findings are emitted separately. Invalid references remain rejected; a same-run manual resume preserves completed specialist outputs.

limits: Deterministic checks are separate from model behavior.
No general quality score, hosted activation or next scheduled success is established by a manual replay.
Personal packets, request text, relationship records and drafts remain outside Git.
